verses.en: Hear ye the word which the LORD speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:
verses.pt: Ouvi a palavra que o SENHOR fala sobre vós, ó casa de Israel.
verses.en_web: Hear the word which Yahweh speaks to you, house of Israel!
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to the word which the Lord says to you, O people of Israel:

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.
verses.pt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Não aprendais o caminho das nações, nem vos espanteis dos sinais do céu; ainda que as nações as temam.
verses.en_web: Yahweh says, “Don’t learn the way of the nations, and don’t be dismayed at the signs of the sky; for the nations are dismayed at them.
verses.en_bbe: This is what the Lord has said: Do not go in the way of the nations; have no fear of the signs of heaven, for the nations go in fear of them.

verses.en: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.
verses.pt: Porque as ordenanças dos povos são inúteis; pois cortam madeira do bosque, obra de mãos de artífice, com machado.
verses.en_web: For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cuts a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman with the ax.
verses.en_bbe: For that which is feared by the people is foolish: it is the work of the hands of the workman; for a tree is cut down by him out of the woods with his axe.

verses.en: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.
verses.pt: Com prata e ouro a enfeitam; com pregos e martelo a firmam, para que não se abale.
verses.en_web: They deck it with silver and with gold. They fasten it with nails and with hammers, so that it can’t move.
verses.en_bbe: They make it beautiful with silver and gold; they make it strong with nails and hammers, so that it may not be moved.

verses.en: They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good.
verses.pt: São como espantalhos numa plantação, não podem falar; têm que ser levados, pois não podem andar. Não tenhais temor deles; pois nem podem fazer o mal, nem neles há capacidade de fazer o bem.
verses.en_web: They are like a palm tree, of turned work, and don’t speak. They must be carried, because they can’t move. Don’t be afraid of them; for they can’t do evil, neither is it in them to do good.”
verses.en_bbe: It is like a pillar in a garden of plants, and has no voice: it has to be lifted, for it has no power of walking. Have no fear of it; for it has no power of doing evil and it is not able to do any good.

verses.en: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee, O LORD; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.
verses.pt: Pois ninguém há semelhante a ti, SENHOR! Grande és tu, e grande é teu nome em poder!
verses.en_web: There is no one like you, Yahweh. You are great, and your name is great in might.
verses.en_bbe: There is no one like you, O Lord; you are great and your name is great in power.

verses.en: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto thee.
verses.pt: Quem não temeria a ti, ó Rei das nações? Porque a ti pertence o temor; porque entre todos os sábios das nações, e em todos seus reinos, não há semelhante a ti.
verses.en_web: Who shouldn’t fear you, King of the nations? For it belongs to you. Because among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their royal estate, there is no one like you.
verses.en_bbe: Who would not have fear of you, O King of the nations? for it is your right: for among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is no one like you.

verses.en: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.
verses.pt: E juntamente se tornaram irracionais e tolos. Ensino inútil é o ídolo de madeira.
verses.en_web: But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood.
verses.en_bbe: But they are together like beasts and foolish: the teaching of false gods is wood.

verses.en: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple is their clothing: they are all the work of cunning men.
verses.pt: Trazem prata estendida de Társis, e ouro de Ufaz; para trabalho do artífice, e das mãos do fundidor; eles os vestem de azul celeste e de púrpura; todos eles são obra de trabalhadores habilidosos.
verses.en_web: There is silver beaten into plates, which is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the engraver and of the hands of the goldsmith. Their clothing is blue and purple. They are all the work of skillful men.
verses.en_bbe: Silver hammered into plates is sent from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the expert workman and of the hands of the gold-worker; blue and purple is their clothing, all the work of expert men.

verses.en: But the LORD is the true God, he is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.
verses.pt: Mas o SENHOR Deus é a verdade; ele é Deus vivo e o Rei eterno; a terra treme pela sua ira, e as nações não podem suportar sua fúria.
verses.en_web: But Yahweh is the true God. He is the living God, and an everlasting King. At his wrath, the earth trembles. The nations aren’t able to withstand his indignation.
verses.en_bbe: But the Lord is the true God; he is the living God and an eternal king: when he is angry, the earth is shaking with fear, and the nations give way before his wrath.

verses.en: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.
verses.pt: Assim lhes direis: Os deuses que não fizeram os céus nem a terra perecerão da terra e de debaixo deste céu.
verses.en_web: “You shall say this to them: ‘The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.’”
verses.en_bbe: This is what you are to say to them: The gods who have not made the heavens and the earth will be cut off from the earth and from under the heavens.

verses.en: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.
verses.pt: Mas o SENHOR é aquele que fez a terra com seu poder, que preparou o mundo com sua sabedoria, e estendeu os céus com seu entendimento.
verses.en_web: God has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens.
verses.en_bbe: He has made the earth by his power, he has made the world strong in its place by his wisdom, and by his wise design the heavens have been stretched out.

verses.en: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
verses.pt: Quando ele pronuncia sua voz, logo há ruído de águas no céu, e faz subir vapores dos confins da terra; faz os relâmpagos com a chuva, e faz sair o vento de seus tesouros.
verses.en_web: When he utters his voice, the waters in the heavens roar, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries.
verses.en_bbe: At the sound of his voice there is a massing of waters in the heavens, and he makes the mists go up from the ends of the earth; he makes the thunder-flames for the rain, and sends out the wind from his store-houses.

verses.en: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
verses.pt: Todo homem se tornou irracional e sem conhecimento; envergonha-se todo fundidor de imagem de escultura, pois sua imagem fundida é uma mentira, e nelas não há espírito.
verses.en_web: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
verses.en_bbe: Then every man becomes like a beast without knowledge; every gold-worker is put to shame by the image he has made: for his metal image is deceit, and there is no breath in them.

verses.en: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.pt: Elas são inúteis, obras de engano; no tempo de sua punição, virão a perecer.
verses.en_web: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation they will perish.
verses.en_bbe: They are nothing, a work of error: in the time of their punishment, destruction will overtake them.

verses.en: The portion of Jacob is not like them: for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: The LORD of hosts is his name.
verses.pt: A Porção de Jacó não é como eles; porque ele é o Formador de tudo, e Israel é a tribo de sua herança; EU-SOU dos exércitos é o seu nome.
verses.en_web: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance: Yahweh of Armies is his name.
verses.en_bbe: The heritage of Jacob is not like these; for the maker of all things is his heritage: the Lord of armies is his name.

verses.en: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.
verses.pt: Recolhe tuas mercadorias da terra; tu que habitas em cerco,
verses.en_web: Gather up your wares out of the land, you who live under siege.
verses.en_bbe: Get your goods together and go out of the land, O you who are shut up in the walled town.

verses.en: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find it so.
verses.pt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que desta vez lançarei como que por uma funda aos moradores da terra; e eu os oprimirei, de modo que sejam achados em opressão.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh says, “Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and will distress them, that they may feel it.”
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord has said, I will send the people in flight like a stone from the land at this time, troubling them so that they will be conscious of it.

verses.en: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is a grief, and I must bear it.
verses.pt: Ai de mim, por causa do meu quebrantamento! Minha ferida me causa grande dor. E eu havia dito: Isto de fato é uma enfermidade, e terei que suportá-la.
verses.en_web: Woe is me because of my injury! My wound is serious; but I said, “Truly this is my grief, and I must bear it.”
verses.en_bbe: Sorrow is mine for I am wounded! my wound may not be made well; and I said, Cruel is my disease, I may not be free from it.

verses.en: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.
verses.pt: Minha tenda está destruída, e todas as minhas cordas arrebentadas; meus filhos saíram de perto de mim, e nenhum deles há; ninguém há que estenda minha tenda, nem que levante minhas cortinas;
verses.en_web: My tent has been destroyed, and all my cords are broken. My children have gone away from me, and they are no more. There is no one to spread my tent any more, to set up my curtains.
verses.en_bbe: My tent is pulled down and all my cords are broken: my children have gone from me, and they are not: no longer is there anyone to give help in stretching out my tent and hanging up my curtains.

verses.en: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the LORD: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.
verses.pt: Porque os pastores se tornaram irracionais, e não buscaram ao SENHOR; por isso não agiram prudentemente, e todo o seu rebanho se dispersou.
verses.en_web: For the shepherds have become brutish, and have not inquired of Yahweh. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flocks have scattered.
verses.en_bbe: For the keepers of the sheep have become like beasts, not looking to the Lord for directions: so they have not done wisely and all their flocks have been put to flight.

verses.en: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate, and a den of dragons.
verses.pt: Eis que vem uma voz de aviso, e um grande tremor da terra do norte; para tornar em desolação as cidades de Judá, em morada de chacais.
verses.en_web: The voice of news, behold, it comes, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a dwelling place of jackals.
verses.en_bbe: News is going about, see, it is coming, a great shaking is coming from the north country, so that the towns of Judah may be made waste and become the living-place of jackals.

verses.en: O LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.
verses.pt: Eu sei, SENHOR, que não pertence ao homem o seu caminho, nem ao homem que anda a direção de seus passos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself. It is not in man who walks to direct his steps.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, I am conscious that a man's way is not in himself: man has no power of guiding his steps.

verses.en: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.
verses.pt: Corrige-me, SENHOR, porém com moderação; não em tua ira, para que não me destruas.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, correct me, but gently; not in your anger, lest you reduce me to nothing.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, put me right, but with wise purpose; not in your wrath, or you will make me small.

verses.en: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
verses.pt: Derrama tua ira sobre as nações que não te conhecem, e sobre os povos que não invocam o teu nome; pois devoraram a Jacó; eles o devoraram, consumiram e assolaram sua morada.
verses.en_web: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, and on the families that don’t call on your name; for they have devoured Jacob. Yes, they have devoured him, consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.
verses.en_bbe: Let your wrath be let loose on the nations which have no knowledge of you, and on the families who give no worship to your name: for they have made a meal of Jacob, truly they have made a meal of him and put an end to him and made his fields a waste.
